name: stun_then_immune
description: The Toll Tower's stun (design 3.2, contract-m6 3): a pulse stands a ground creep still for 0.6 s (36 ticks), then leaves it immune for 1 s, so stuns never chain. A second Toll Tower ringing during the immunity hurts the Thornback but stuns nothing; the first one's next pulse, once the immunity is over, stuns it again. On a boss, where control resistance is on, the stun is a 50% slow of the same length, not shrunk again by the Bristlesow's 30% resistance; classic has no resistance, so there it stands.

steps.assert: toll.kind == 'toll_tower' and toll.pulse and toll.stun_t == 36 and toll.stun_immune_t == 60
steps.msg: a Toll Tower stands: a pulse that stuns 36 ticks, then 60 of immunity

steps.assert: p1.size() == 1 and p1[0]['tick'] == rang - 1 and p1[0]['r'] == 2200
steps.msg: it rings at once with the Thornback in reach (EV_PULSE)
stunned for 36 ticks, then immune for 60 (EV_STATUS stun)
and walks on the tick the stun ends
a second Toll Tower rings during the immunity and its pulse hurts the Thornback
but stuns nothing: stuns never chain

steps.assert: scene.pulses(toll.id).size() == 2 and scene.events_where('STATUS', {'creep': c, 'effect': 2}).size() == 2 and scene.creep(c).stun_until == p1[0]['tick'] + 144 + 36
steps.msg: the first tower's next pulse, after the immunity, stuns it again
and the second tower's next one finds it immune again
each pulse deals 8 through the armour rule (Bronze Hand ignores 2 of its 4)
on the Bristlesow the stun is a slow of 50%, not 35%

steps.assert: b.slow_pm == 500 and b.slow_until == rang2 - 1 + 36 and b.slow_seat == 1 and b.stun_immune_until == rang2 - 1 + 96
steps.msg: for the stun's 36 ticks, with the immunity after it
it walks at half its speed meanwhile
classic turns resistance off: there the Crest is stunned
